description: Pinned external lncRNA catalogs for F2.1/F2.2. NONCODE is the recommended primary catalog and RNAcentral the recommended second (it aggregates lncRNA catalogs). Fill `version` and `url` with the exact pinned release before running --mode download. `file` may be set to an existing local BED instead of downloading. BED contract: tab-separated, 0-based, col4 = feature id, col6 = strand. Feature counts and md5 are recorded in run_info/external_catalogs.tsv.

sources.name: noncode
sources.note: Recommended primary. NONCODE v6 human hg38 BED; needs a browser User-Agent to download. Record the exact release used.

sources.name: rnacentral
sources.note: Recommended second. RNAcentral GRCh38 genome-coordinates BED12 covering all ncRNA types (not lncRNA-only).

sources.name: lncipedia
sources.note: Optional / legacy. lncipedia.org is inactive; use only a verifiable mirror. Non-commercial licence.

sources.name: fantomcat
sources.note: Optional. FANTOM CAT, only if an hg38 BED exists.
